build_voxel_head: build a voxel head from config using build_voxel_head with cfg and input_shape
compute_voxel_rcnn_loss: compute the voxel prediction loss using voxel_rcnn_loss with pred_voxel_logits and instances
run_voxel_rcnn_inference: run voxel inference to attach pred_voxels to instances using voxel_rcnn_inference
review_VoxelRCNNConvUpsampleHead: review the VoxelRCNNConvUpsampleHead class which builds a conv-based voxel prediction head with upsampling
register_roi_voxel_head: register a custom ROI voxel head class with ROI_VOXEL_HEAD_REGISTRY for use in Mesh R-CNN
